row.notes: vtable slot (0x145790988) of the ERS system: per-participant ERS tick; skips an entry whose +0x28 vehicle component or its +0x5a8 ERS state is null (the check Game_ErsSystem_HandleVehicleNewLap lacks). | engine-re 2026-10-28 (static): overtake button (car+0x1ed bits 0x10/0x08) latches ERS mode 2 and stores the previous mode in +0x1a6c, restores on release; in race sessions locks Hotlap (EngineModeAvail bit 0x200) while F1Aero+0x19ac = 2026 Partial mode (not DRS open, see Game_DRS_UpdateCars) | findings from PR #474 by vogtmarcel07-cloud | engine-re E1 2026-11-18 (static): the overtake bits it tests (CarLive+0x1ed 0x10 at 0x1425186ca, 0x08 at 0x142518767) are the per-tick latch of CarLive+0x1b9 bits 4/3, which Sess_ControllerSystem_ApplyRecord sets from the Overtake action (InputRecord bits 22/21). Player setting [NePlayer+0x619] picks toggle (0x10 edge) or hold (0x08); the latch to ERS mode 2 needs ctrlSys ERS-auto +0xd6 == 0 and EngineModeAvail [0x14606ec28]+0x40+veh*0x20 == 0 (mode 2 available) and ERS state +0x5a8 present. On a car without ERS the bits are still set, only this consumer does nothing.
